The '''Triathoggoth organized crime clan''' was a [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] criminal organization based on [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]]. Its reputed leader during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was [[Jorkatt]] the Render.
